Priya / team — looping in quick pricing and billing options so procurement has numbers for the PO: 

Summary pricing (high level) — deal ACME-2027-0042:
- Hosted API: $0.015 / 1k tokens (input+output aggregated) — estimated monthly $6k–9k based on discussed volume
- Dedicated (reserved) baseline: reserved capacity pricing starts at $18k/mo (if you need predictable throughput and private tenancy)
- One-time onboarding fee (if private deployment chosen): $12,500 (optional)

Payment terms: Redwood standard Net 30. We can consider Net 60 for enterprise agreements on annual contracts — would need exec approval (I can escalate).

Marissa — if this looks in-line, I'll prepare a short pricing appendix and send the finalized SOW + invoice remit details so procurement can complete vendor form and issue PO.
